The article is mathematically coherent from its family-level rank and nonvanishing questions through mean-square estimates, zero detection, an explicit-formula reduction, arithmetic averaging, and construction of the required test kernel. within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Moment quality as a shared family-level bottleneck
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: The same family-estimate loss propagates through two distinct interfaces: Cauchy-Schwarz turns it into a nonvanishing-density loss, while zero density plus an explicit formula turns it into an average-rank loss.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: This is a within-paper sensitivity mechanism for one fixed elliptic curve's quadratic twists, not a universal equivalence between moment quality and rank statistics.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: A two-output zero detector stabilized by parameter balancing
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: A zero is forced to reveal itself through either a mollified L-integral or a tail polynomial; estimating both and choosing auxiliary lengths where their costs meet yields a uniform density exponent.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The detector is solver- and coefficient-bound specific, and exact exponents rely on the stated large-sieve input.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Test-function design as interface matching
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: The kernel is designed backward from three downstream jobs--functional-equation symmetry, horizontal contour decay, and positivity for central multiplicity--then realized by infinite convolution and a positivity-preserving transform factor.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The construction proves existence with sufficient decay and positivity; it does not claim optimality or uniqueness.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Arithmetic family structure closes an analytic explicit formula
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: After the explicit formula exposes prime terms, the nonconsecutive twist family becomes tractable only after fundamental discriminants are decomposed into square-free congruence classes, enabling character-sum cancellation before zero density handles the remaining spectral obstruction.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The cancellation bound and final rank estimate are average, conditional on the paper's density hypothesis, and tied to this discriminant parametrization.
